margin_selection_rule: Among margins whose val target exact-accuracy drop from the gate-disabled baseline is at most the regression budget, pick the lowest incomplete_prefix_far_excl_digital_zero (NOT incomplete_prefix_far, which includes digital-zero-padded probes); ties break toward the smallest margin. R2-6: digital-zero padding is not acoustically neutral and was found to understate the false-accept rate, biasing selection toward too small a margin -- excluded from the selection criterion. incomplete_prefix_far (all probes) and incomplete_prefix_far_digital_zero_only are still reported on every grid row for visibility.
